setting: environment exact, training seeds 301,302,303,304,305 (5 runs per arm)

selection.rule: best validation score of the kept checkpoint (arm_registry.select_seed)

production_policy_minus_rival_rule: d = 100 (policy - rival) / rival per instance (negative = policy shorter), recomputed from the arrays; same sources, instance-level cluster bootstrap (B = 20000, fresh default_rng(7)) as production; regimes_ahead and seed counts use the interval below zero
superiority_verdict_rule: ahead: hierarchical 95% CI below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values (seed-level t, bootstrap; H1 first arm faster) below 0.05; behind: CI above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for H1 first arm slower (own Holm family over the eight combinations) below 0.05; not distinguishable otherwise

production_solver_1800s.reason: skipped in the exact environment: the solver comparison at the production batches comes from scripts/p94_timed_inference.py (the timed campaign); or_solution/FAMILY/{50x25,80x25}_fairwarm1800s are not read and no macro of them is written

sections_rule: a section is computed when every input array of the active environment and seeds exists with as many rows as its folder has test instances, and listed as skipped with the reason otherwise; --require-sections refuses a skipped section. d = 100 (first - second) / second, seed s against seed s; hierarchical intervals from a fresh default_rng(11) per quantity, instance-level intervals (selected run) from a fresh default_rng(7); combined verdicts as superiority_verdict_rule, Holm over the twelve pairs (F) or the eight combinations of a size (H)
